Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

PROFORMA FOR PURCHASE SPECIFICATION FOR 

MACHINE TOOLS 

PART 1 GENERAL PURPOSE PARALLEL LATHES 
AMD PRECISION LATHES 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Recommends the proforma for preparation of purchase specification for general 
purpose parallel lathes and precision lathes. It also gives essential information about these lathes 
at their accessories which will enable the user to assess the usefulness and suitability for 
requirements.

tive capacity chart for lathes ): 

a) Hardness of guideways, and 

b) Any other special features.

IS :6893 (Parti ) - 1988 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The proforma for preparation of purchase specification for machine tools has been prepared 
to enable a respective buyer to collect data from various manufacturers/suppliers for purposes of 
comparison. This is meant to be sent out with an enquiry by the purchaser so lhat the manufac- 
turers/suppliers can fill in the data and send it back to the purchaser to make the comparison 
easier for the purchaser. 

Reference is made to the following Indian Standards in this standard: 

IS : 5-1978 Colours for ready mixed paints and enamels ( third revision ) 

IS : 1231-1974 Dimensions of three phase foot mounted induction motors ( third revision ) 

IS : 1715-1986 Dimensions for self holding tapers ( second revision ) 

IS : 1878 ( Part 1 )- Test chart for general purpose parallel lathes: Part 1 Lathes with swing over 
1971 bed up to 800 mm ( first revision ) 

IS : 1878 ( Part 2 )- Test chart for general purpose parallel lathes: Part 2 Lathes with swing over 
1971 bed over 800 mm and up to 1 600 mm ( first revision ) 

IS : 1983-1985 Shank sections for single point turning and planing tools ( first revision ) 

IS : 2582 ( Part 1 )- Spindle noses — type * A ' ( first revision ) 
1972 

IS : 2582 ( Part 2 )- Spindle noses — camlock type ( first revision ) 
1972 

IS : 2582 ( Part 3 )- Spindle noses bayonet type ( first revision ) 
1972 

IS : 4218 ( Parts 1 ISO metric screw threads 
to 6) 

IS : 4691-1985 Degrees of protection provided by enclosures for rotating electrical 

machinery ( first revision ) 

IS : 4729-1968 Measurement and evaluation of vibration of rotating electrical machines 

IS : 6040-1971 Test chart for precision lathes — Lathes with swing over bed up to 500 mm 

and distance between centre up to 1 500 mm 

IS : 9474-1980 Principle of mechanical guarding of machinery 

IS : 10988-1984 Method of measuring noise from machine tools (excluding testing in 

anechoic chambers ) 

In the present revision, detailed requirements of motors and coolant pumps and requirements 
for environmental and safety aspects have also been included in the proforma. 



Printed at New India Printing Press, Khurja. India
